## What's new

- **Settings in six tabs.** General keeps Dowlio in the menu bar and the Dock, updates, and Report a Problem. Notifications takes what happens when a download finishes or fails, and what clicking a notification does. Downloads keeps the folder, file names and history. Video takes quality, Prefer H.264 MP4, subtitles and the tools. Connections and Browsers stay as they were.
- **A subtitle language list that scrolls.** Languages sit in a fixed-height list, so adding more no longer grows the window. Each row is numbered, and the first is preferred. Click a row to select it, drag it to reorder, and use the buttons under the list to add or remove one. A scroll bar stays in sight when the list is longer than its box.

## Before you update

- **Allow the keychain prompt.** After this update, macOS asks once whether Dowlio may read its saved browser pairings. Choose Always Allow. Your browsers stay paired.
